description: Pixel art scene, close view of an awards ceremony stage filling the whole frame in an elegant 1990s Hong Kong hotel grand ballroom: a wide raised stage with deep red velvet curtains drawn open to the left and right edges, a small golden podium standing on the stage near the centre, large crystal chandeliers along the top edge, ornate cream ceiling with gold trim above the curtains, warm golden lighting, dark wood panelled side walls with wall sconces. The stage platform top edge runs horizontally across the middle of the frame with a clear straight edge. No chairs, no audience, no red carpet, no people, no text, no logos, no words anywhere. Clean flat-shaded pixel art, warm cream, gold, deep red and dark wood palette.
